decision_titles: Cemetery name sign design and installation
Three price options for donated cemetery benches
plain_text:
Page 1 
Sextons Committee 
Draft Minutes 
November 10 , 2026  
 
The Sexton’s committee held a regular meeting on November 10th, 2026 at 3:00 pm, in 
180 Market Street, 3rd Floor Conference Room 301, and by 
Zoom  https://zoom.us/j/97442869500.  
Members present: Chuck Rainville, Jennifer McClory, Peter Taylor, Richard Thorngren, 
Elise Guyette, James Kennedy 
Also present: City Council Liaison Andrew Chalnick; Andy Brumbaugh, City of South 
Burlington.   
1. First item: Meeting called to order at 3:02pm. 
 
2. Second item: No changes to the agenda.  
 
3. No comments from the public. 
 
4. October 13, 2026 minutes approved unanimously. 
 
5. Chair’s Comments: An article on the beautification of Eldredge Cemetery appeared 
in the City newsletter and the Other Paper; no inquiries about watering or painting 
were received. A comment was submitted on the 60% draft Park & Open Space 
Master Plan, advocating for a park north of the Shelburne Road cemetery to 
provide access from Fayette Drive. Peter will look into joining the master plan’s 
Community Advisory Group (CAG). The sexton’s FY2026 Annual Report has been 
submitted. The State delegation representing South Burlington will request draft 
language for a municipal exemption allowing columbaria in cemeteries under 5 
acres. It is unclear whether cemeteries operating before June 1, 1933 are 
grandfathered, and whether that could be a path to allowing columbaria. Chuck will 
email Colin McNeil to ask whether he can give an opinion on grandfathering.
Sexton Committee Metting November 10, 2026 | Page 2 
6. Presentation by Andy Brumbaugh on cemetery signage options for the City 
cemeteries and the rules signs to be installed.  The new signs would have a lifespan 
of 15 to 20 years.  The Committee decided on three-foot wide signs for the names 
with double post installation.  Shape one was selected.  Examples in green or blue, 
with fonts Lucy Rose or ITC Berkley, and the city logo in color and not  in color will 
be presented at the December meeting for further discussion. Rules sign examples 
in white, green and blue backgrounds will be presented. 
 
7. In reviewing sample bench materials that Chuck photographed in the area the 
committee decided to offer three price points for donated benches. 1) powder 
coated black metal bench; 2) flat granite bench; 3) granite bench with back. The 
committee will determine the make and model of the metal bench option but has 
no requirements beyond material for the granite benches.    
 
8. Draft notes from a meeting with the water superintendent were shared with 
possible methods to bring water service to Eldredge cemetery.  Tapping into the 
current water line to the Heritage property south of the Cemetery may avert the 
need to cross Airport Drive to access a water line. Next steps are to receive 
approved notes from the water superintendent and then meet with Public Works to 
see what capacity and input the department might have to help with the project.  
More progress to advance  pricing will be possible after that.  
 
9. Chuck is getting ballpark prices to make some cosmetic repairs to the fencing at 
Eldredge cemetery at the sign and gate entrances.  
 
10. Nick Garty’s Tree City USA planting event was held on October 24th.  Six or so 
volunteers and Nick planted 8 bare root trees, four interior and four along Airport 
Drive to replace the removed ash trees.  Two additional trees are planned for the 
south fence line once sourced.   
 
11. Peter Taylor updated the committee on the shopping cart in, and tent behind 
Shelburne Road Cemetery. The belongings have been present in the cart for more 
than a month without being removed.  Peter would like the written protocol on how 
to report abandoned property and illegal camping.   
 
12. Chuck provided a record of reimbursed expenses incurred in 2025 and 2026 in 
performance of Sextons duties for review.   
 
13. No other business was raised, and the committee was adjourned at 4:33.
